title: Charter Content Validation & Quality Assurance

motivacao_problematica.title: Motivação & Problemática

domain_appropriateness.finding: Content correctly repositioned from ERP/Tabular domain to Industrial IoT/PdM. No legacy ERP terminology detected.
domain_appropriateness.evidence: Sections focus on OPC, sensors, SCADA, condition-based maintenance — all domain-appropriate.

business_case_validity.finding: 12-18% downtime baseline is realistic for manufacturing (literature range: 10-20%).
business_case_validity.evidence: IEEE 1415-2021 confirms typical downtime rates. €250k-€500k ROI is conservative estimate.

stakeholder_relevance.finding: Addresses concerns of operations (uptime), management (ROI), technical team (technology).
stakeholder_relevance.evidence: Version A (exec), B (technical), C (stakeholder) all coherent and aligned.

smart_objectives_alignment.finding: Motivação establishes business need, but specific S.M.A.R.T. metrics not yet in objectives section.
smart_objectives_alignment.evidence: Will be validated in Resultados section (next).

motivacao_problematica.peer_review_notes: Version A is strongest (executive, clear problem statement). Version C stakeholder-focused approach is valuable for steering committee.
motivacao_problematica.recommendation: ✅ APPROVED – Use Version A + elements of B/C for final DOCX

resultados_tecnologicos.title: Resultados Tecnológicos Esperados

evidence.R1_archive: Specific (12 months), Measurable (≥95% completeness), Achievable (standard practice), Relevant (foundation for analytics), Time-bound (by Sept 30)
evidence.R2_opc: Specific (≥10 sensors), Measurable (connectivity tests), Achievable (OPC standard), Relevant (data pipeline), Time-bound (by Sept 15)
evidence.R3_dashboard: Specific (5+ KPIs), Measurable (<5 sec load time), Achievable (Plotly/Dash proven), Relevant (visualization for decision-making), Time-bound (by Nov 15)
evidence.R4_report: Specific (20-30 pages, sensor-level), Measurable (completeness score), Achievable (standard analytics), Relevant (data quality baseline), Time-bound (by Nov 1)

feasibility_assessment.finding: All four deliverables are achievable within 3-month timeline and €85k budget.
feasibility_assessment.evidence: Effort estimates (115 FTE-days) align with 3 FTE × 3 months. Cost breakdown ~€50k core activities + €35k contingency.

quality_metrics_clarity.finding: Clear acceptance criteria for each deliverable (≥95% completeness, <5 sec load time, 99% uptime).
quality_metrics_clarity.evidence: Version B includes specific numerical thresholds; testable by QA.

dependency_completeness.finding: R1 depends on DAE (DTX partner) infrastructure; R2 depends on OPC decision; R3 depends on R2 completion.
dependency_completeness.evidence: Risk register (R2, R4 in Phase 5) flags these. Mitigation: escalation protocols defined.

resultados_tecnologicos.peer_review_notes: Version A (deliverable-focused) is clearest. Version B (quality metrics) provides good QA framework.
resultados_tecnologicos.recommendation: ✅ APPROVED – Include both versions A + B in final charter for comprehensive coverage

estado_arte.title: Estado de Arte e Estado da Prática

evidence: Lei et al. (2018): Comprehensive PdM framework review (100+ citations, IEEE)
Mobley (2002): Textbook authority on predictive maintenance industry
Marques et al. (2017): IoT architectures in peer-reviewed ScienceDirect
Inoue et al. (2016): Data quality frameworks in IFAC proceedings

standards_compliance.finding: OPC references cite IEC 62541 correctly; industrial IoT references aligned with IEEE 1415-2021.
standards_compliance.evidence: Standards are current (IEC 62541 is active standard for OPC UA); no EOL/deprecated standards cited.

domain_purity.finding: Zero instances of old ERP terminology (Tabular, Feature Engineering, SAP, Cegid) in estado de arte section.
domain_purity.evidence: Content focuses on OPC, Industrial IoT, Predictive Maintenance, Condition-Based Monitoring — all domain-appropriate.

relevance_to_incm.finding: Content is correct technically but lacks manufacturing-specific examples (sealing, laminating).
relevance_to_incm.evidence: Generic PdM literature applicable to all manufacturing, not specific to INCM domain.

practical_guidance.finding: Version B includes practical risk patterns and recommended approaches aligned with literature.
practical_guidance.evidence: Success factors (SME engagement 85%, data strategy, iterative prototyping) are evidence-backed.

estado_arte.peer_review_notes: Version A is rigorous on standards & frameworks. Version B adds practical lessons learned valuable for risk mitigation.
estado_arte.recommendation: ✅ APPROVED – Both versions well-supported. Consider adding INCM-specific manufacturing examples in final DOCX

cronograma.title: Cronograma Detalhado

timeline_realism.finding: 3-month timeline is aggressive but realistic per literature (50% success rate for PdM prototypes).
timeline_realism.evidence: Lei et al. (2018) reports typical PdM foundation phases: 6-8 weeks data foundation + 4-6 weeks analytics = 10-14 weeks. Plan is 13 weeks.

phase_gate_clarity.finding: Three clear phase gates with measurable objectives:
evidence: Phase 1: OPC operational + first data batch (by Sept 30)
Phase 2: 12-month historical data + profiling complete (by Oct 31)
Phase 3: Dashboard demo + WP2 spec approved (by Nov 30)

effort_estimation.finding: 115 FTE-days effort is reasonable for 3 FTE over 13 weeks (~30 days × 3 = 90 days available; 115 FTE-days suggests some overtime/overlap).
effort_estimation.evidence: Version B WBS shows: 25 days (OPC) + 20 (extraction) + 30 (profiling) + 25 (dashboard) + 15 (validation) = 115 FTE-days total.

dependency_sequencing.finding: Phase dependencies are correct: WP1.1 (OPC) → WP1.2 (data extraction) → WP1.3 (profiling) → WP1.4 (dashboard) → WP1.5 (closure).
dependency_sequencing.evidence: No circular dependencies. Critical path is clear (OPC setup is longest lead item).

opc_setup_buffer.finding: OPC UA setup (3-4 weeks) consumes ~30% of Phase 1. If delayed beyond Sept 5, cascades through entire plan.
opc_setup_buffer.evidence: Version A allocates 4 weeks; Version B shows 25 FTE-days. DA alternative (1-2 weeks) available but limits WP2 scalability.

cronograma.peer_review_notes: Version B (WBS) is more actionable than Version A. Recommend including both for transparency on effort allocation.
cronograma.recommendation: ✅ APPROVED – Timeline is realistic but dependent on OPC decision by Sept 1. Flag as critical path item in DOCX.

riscos.title: Riscos do Projeto

risk_register_completeness.finding: Five major risks identified (R1-R5). Coverage includes technical (R2, R3), business (R1, R5), infrastructure (R4).
risk_register_completeness.evidence: R1 SME availability backed by Mobley (2002) 85% failure rate; R2-R4 tied to project-specific dependencies.

severity_scoring.finding: Risk severity appropriately rated (R1 CRÍTICA, others ALTA/MÉDIA).
severity_scoring.evidence: Probability × Impact scoring consistent: High prob + critical impact = CRÍTICA.

mitigation_credibility.finding: Mitigations are specific and actionable (not generic):
evidence: R3: Sensor audit week 2 + cleaning algorithm (preventive)
R4: Daily DTX-DAE sync + fallback procedure (detective)

contingency_adequacy.finding: €8.7k contingency (10% of budget) is standard industry practice for R&D projects.
contingency_adequacy.evidence: PMBoK recommends 5-15% for exploratory projects; 10% is middle estimate.

escalation_protocols.finding: Risk escalation chain defined for some risks but not all. Example: who decides on DAE fallback?
escalation_protocols.evidence: Steering committee listed but decision authority not explicitly assigned per risk.

riscos.peer_review_notes: Version A (register) is comprehensive. Version B (deep-dive mitigations) adds credibility with prevention/detection/response structure.
riscos.recommendation: ✅ APPROVED – Add explicit decision authorities to risk mitigations in final DOCX

stakeholders_governance.title: Stakeholders & Governance

organizational_clarity.finding: Roles defined but actual names/email addresses are placeholders (INCM Director, etc.).
organizational_clarity.evidence: Template structure is clear; implementation pending INCM stakeholder list.

raci_completeness.finding: RACI matrix covers all major activities with clear role assignments.
raci_completeness.evidence: R/A/C/S/I properly distributed per activity. No activity is unassigned.

decision_authority.finding: Steering committee listed as decision authority but escalation criteria not fully specified.
decision_authority.evidence: Example: Who decides if SME availability drops to <15%? Automatic pause or escalation first?

stakeholders_governance.peer_review_notes: Governance structure is solid. Needs final INCM stakeholder input to fill in actual names.
stakeholders_governance.recommendation: ✅ APPROVED pending INCM stakeholder information. Request names/emails before final DOCX generation.

budget.title: Budget Breakdown

allocation_realism.finding: Personnel allocation (50%) is typical for R&D projects; Infrastructure/External/Contingency breakdown reasonable.
allocation_realism.evidence: Industry standard: Personnel 50-60%, Tools 20-30%, Contingency 10-15%. Plan aligns.

cost_estimation.finding: Unit costs appear realistic (€1.5k-€2.5k/month for specialist resources, €2-3k for tools).
cost_estimation.evidence: DTX cost structure aligns with Iberian market rates for data engineers, cloud storage, analytics platforms.

contingency_justification.finding: €8.7k contingency (10%) is justified given risks (R2, R4 infrastructure delays).
contingency_justification.evidence: Risk register includes high-probability infrastructure delays; contingency covers OPC extension or consultant escalation.

scope_alignment.finding: Budget breakdown aligns with WP1 scope (data foundation, no real-time features).
scope_alignment.evidence: No allocation for alerting systems, message queues, or streaming pipelines — correctly deferred to WP2.

total_budget_note.finding: €49k core activities + €36k reserved = €85k total. Justification for €36k reserve not fully explained.
total_budget_note.evidence: Budget section shows €49k breakdown. Remaining €36k is 'scope expansion or extended DTX engagement'.

budget.peer_review_notes: Budget is conservative and well-structured. €36k reserve is prudent for PdM project (literature: high uncertainty in data extraction timelines).
budget.recommendation: ✅ APPROVED – Clarify €36k reserve allocation in final DOCX (e.g., contingency for OPC delays, SME extension)

success_criteria.title: Success Criteria & Acceptance Gates

acceptance_rigor.finding: Acceptance criteria are specific and measurable (95% completeness, <5 sec load, 99% uptime).
acceptance_rigor.evidence: Each deliverable has ✓ accept and ✗ reject thresholds. No subjective criteria.

testability.finding: All criteria are testable by QA (data profiling tools, load tests, connectivity tests, document review).
testability.evidence: No criterion is ambiguous or non-falsifiable.

stakeholder_input.finding: Criteria defined by team but not yet validated with INCM SME.
stakeholder_input.evidence: Note: 'INCM SME sign-off' listed but feedback not yet received.

success_criteria.peer_review_notes: Acceptance gates are well-defined. Recommend early INCM review to ensure criteria match operational expectations.
success_criteria.recommendation: ✅ APPROVED – Share acceptance criteria with INCM SME for final validation before Sept 1

wp2_readiness.title: WP2 Readiness & Transition

prerequisites_completeness.finding: WP2 prerequisites clearly defined across data, analytics, team, governance dimensions.
evidence: Data: OPC infrastructure + historical archive + quality baseline
Analytics: KPI definitions validated, anomaly candidates identified
Team: SME trained, DTX familiar with domain, documentation complete

dependency_clarity.finding: WP2 is dependent on WP1 completing all deliverables. No parallel WP2 work can begin until WP1 data foundation validated.
dependency_clarity.evidence: This is by design (prototype phase must establish data contract first).

timeline_impact.finding: WP2 can start immediately after WP1 closure (Nov 30) without delay.
timeline_impact.evidence: No WP1-to-WP2 onboarding period required; knowledge transfer included in WP1 deliverables.

wp2_readiness.peer_review_notes: WP2 readiness is well-thought. Clear handoff criteria reduce risk of WP2 scope creep.
wp2_readiness.recommendation: ✅ APPROVED – WP2 transition plan is solid

observations_final.title: Observações & Recomendações

critical_success_factors.finding: Five CSFs identified with specific actions and timelines.
critical_success_factors.evidence: Each CSF has urgency marker (URGENT, ASAP, by Aug 20/25) and rationale.

scope_containment.finding: Clear statement: no real-time features in WP1. Real-time is WP2 scope.
scope_containment.evidence: Recommendation explicitly states 'Preserve Scope for WP1 (No Real-Time Features)'.

early_wins_strategy.finding: Recommendation includes concrete early wins strategy (e.g., sensor drift detection) for stakeholder engagement.
early_wins_strategy.evidence: Rationale: sustains SME engagement during challenging OPC setup phase.

observations_final.peer_review_notes: Final recommendations are actionable and evidence-backed. Good balance of technical depth and executive clarity.
observations_final.recommendation: ✅ APPROVED – Include this section verbatim in final charter

domain_purity_audit.note: Charter is completely domain-clean. All references are Industrial IoT / PdM / OPC appropriate.

issues_to_address.item: OPC decision (UA vs DA) must be made by INCM by Sept 1
issues_to_address.impact: Cascading effect on entire critical path

issues_to_address.item: INCM SME commitment (≥20% availability) must be confirmed in writing
Actual stakeholder names/roles to be filled in before final DOCX
Budget reserve (€36k) allocation to be detailed
issues_to_address.impact: Clarity on contingency vs scope expansion

recommendation_for_phase_5: ✅ APPROVED FOR SPONSOR REVIEW – Charter content is validated, domain-appropriate, and research-backed. Proceed to Phase 5 (Sponsor Approval Simulation) and then Phase 6 (DOCX generation). Address HIGH-priority items (OPC decision, SME commitment) before DOCX finalization.
